compose_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to chain input and output symbol mappings
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a weighted graph using gtn.forward_score to sum log-space path weights
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
concatenate_graphs: concatenate multiple graphs in sequence using gtn.concat to chain transducer languages end to end
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a graph using gtn.remove to eliminate silent arcs and simplify structure
